ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black/dark-brown pigmentation concentrated along the periphery and trailing edge boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity (white) regions occupy the central lobes. Dark-intensity (black/brown) pixels form a continuous border along the trailing edge and tips. Three distinct vertical dark streaks are located on the lower-left quadrant. Small clusters of high-contrast yellow/orange circular pixels are located on the lower-left and lower-right areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees, exhibiting dark pigmentation at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels. The boundary is characterized by sharp, non-uniform peaks and valleys across the entire trailing span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a broad upward convexity, sweeping from the lower insertion point toward elevated lateral tips, forming a wide 'W' profile along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular yellow-brown pixel clusters: a pair in the lower-left interior, a cluster of three in the lower-right interior, and several smaller clusters located near the lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct vertical dark-pigmented linear disruptions on the mid-to-lower left lobe, ranging from roughly 10 to 40 pixels in vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of barnacle-like protrusions are visible on the distal tips of both lobes. The trailing edge displays significant irregular wear/trauma patterns consistent with high-frequency tissue loss or erosion.
other_distinctive_markers: A single isolated dark circular pigmentation spot is located on the upper-right lobe near the trailing edge boundary.
